verdict.rationale: Kong ships a RESTful Admin API on port 8001 for configuring the gateway, and publishes a directory of OpenAPI specifications for its APIs. Official Go bindings for the Admin API and the Konnect REST APIs back this up as supported programmatic surfaces. The probe 404s only show the specs are not at well-known root paths; they do not contradict the documented API directory. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end to end, and a supported (non-prototype) Konnect client SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Advanced routing, load balancing, health checking - all configurable via a RESTful admin API or declarative configuration.
:8001 - configure Kong using Admin API or via [decK](https://github.com/kong/deck)
Directory of OpenAPI specifications for various Kong APIs.
Go bindings for Kong's Admin API
the supported programmatic surfaces are the Konnect REST APIs, the Terraform providers, decK, and kongctl.
